summary: Frontend-only regression test after refactor of GameScreen.js rAF loop into standalone frameScheduler.js module. All 7 requested gameplay flows verified against the web preview. No regressions detected.

test_results.PLAY_starts_run_and_flap_responsive: PASS - PLAY button loads game screen; TAP TO FLAP hint visible; bird responds immediately on click (moved from ~y=350 up to y<20 after taps).
test_results.distance_HUD_smooth_and_monotonic: PASS - Sampled distance every 200ms over 6s: 0,2,3,4,6,6,8,9,11,11,13,14,15,16,18,19,20,21,23,24,25,26,28,28,29,31,32,33,34,35. Strictly non-decreasing, no freezes, no jumps, ~5-6m/s consistent (matches expected 60Hz fixed-step cadence). Refactor confirmed regression-free.
test_results.obstacles_and_chips_render: PASS - Buildings/scaffolding/billboards/chips visible scrolling right-to-left in Gritty Backstreets. Chip HUD present (0 in this short run as bird was flown high to avoid crashes).
test_results.game_over_overlay: PASS - After letting bird fall (~2s) SPLAT! overlay appears with DISTANCE (10m), BEST DISTANCE, CHIPS EATEN, PLAY AGAIN, REVIVE ('Watch an ad to continue'), MAIN MENU. All testids present: game-over-overlay, death-message, new-best-badge, go-distance, go-best-distance, go-chips, play-again-button, revive-button, menu-button.
test_results.restart_confirm_cancel_resumes_same_run: PASS - Clicking restart-button during active run opened restart-confirm-overlay. Distance was 2m at open; after clicking restart-cancel distance was 5m (game kept ticking, state preserved, NOT reset). Confirms the schedulerRef reset was NOT triggered on cancel - the key refactor invariant.
test_results.restart_confirm_yes_starts_new_run: PASS - Clicking restart-confirm-yes reset distance to 0m; new run began cleanly (scheduler.reset(performance.now()) working).
test_results.map_selection_gritty_backstreets: PASS - Selecting map-night then PLAY loaded dark purple night-city theme with pink-lit buildings, scaffolding tower, purple billboards. Distinct from default Sunny London theme.
test_results.menu_exit_returns_home: PASS - Clicking exit-button (MENU) returned to home screen with play-button visible.

critical_code_review_comments: frameScheduler.js is clean, pure, dependency-free, well-commented (49 lines). Good separation of concerns. Testable in isolation as intended.
MAX_FRAME_DT=1/30 correctly caps single-frame catch-up to 2 steps max, preventing burst catch-up after tab-switch/stall.
reset(now) correctly zeroes accumulator - used by cancelRestart/confirmRestartNow via schedulerRef.current.reset(performance.now()) per problem statement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GameScreen loop refactor (rAF + frameScheduler.js) is regression-clean in web preview. Distance HUD increments smoothly and monotonically ~5-6m/s. Restart-cancel preserves run state (distance keeps advancing during confirm modal); restart-yes resets to 0m. Game over overlay + all HUD testids working. Physical Android 90/120Hz stutter fix is explicitly out of scope for web testing per user.
